pages: Fen Sallow, a woman of twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket with the collar turned up, stands between bare apple trees holding one russet apple and talking. Middle distance: a spade pushed into the turf, the long hedge at the end of the row. Background: the orchard hill under a thin March sky, mid-morning.

Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket, stands in the long grass between the rows with one russet apple open in her palm, looking down the line of trees. Middle distance: a folded paper, the hedge. Background: bare orchard rows and low March sun.

Nan Sallow, ninety-five, wispy white hair, a brown knitted shawl over a dark blue wool dress, sits at a kitchen table with a magnifying glass in one hand. Middle distance: a white saucer, a china cup. Background: the kitchen range and a low window, afternoon, coal-smoke light.

Nan Sallow, ninety-five, wispy white hair, a brown knitted shawl over a dark blue wool dress, leans forward at the kitchen table, one finger lifted as if setting a rule down for good. Middle distance: the magnifying glass, the saucer. Background: the range and its blackened iron, winter afternoon.

Nan Sallow, ninety-five, wispy white hair, a brown knitted shawl over a dark blue wool dress, sits by the kitchen range with one hand flat on her knee, talking to the room. Middle distance: the range, a saucer on the fender, a mug on the fender. Background: the kitchen and a low grey window. One warm light, long soft shadows.

A young Nan Sallow of twenty, dark hair pinned up, a brown coat over a plain work dress, kneels in the dark by a hole in the turf with a lantern on the grass and a thin gold ring in her open hand. Middle distance: the spade, the lantern. Background: a row of young apple trees and a hedge, night.

A young Nan Sallow of twenty, dark hair pinned up, a brown coat over a plain work dress, kneels at another hole with a steel thimble in her palm and a small spade beside her knee. Middle distance: the open hole, a lantern on the grass. Background: young apple trees along the hedge, deep night.

Beryl Sallow, seventeen, dark hair under a headscarf, a grey flannel dress with the sleeves pushed up, stands at the kitchen table with a teacup in both hands, talking. Middle distance: a slatted apple bin by the door, a bare bulb, the range. Background: a coal fire, September evening. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Beryl Sallow, seventy-four, grey hair pinned back, a brown cardigan over a blue checked dress, sits turning a cup round and round on the kitchen table. Middle distance: the cup, the bare bulb hanging low. Background: the range and its grey ash, cold winter morning.

Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket with mud on the knees, kneels in the top row holding open a bundle of blue cloth with a thin gold ring showing. Middle distance: the spade blade, the cloth. Background: bare apple trees in a row, April morning.

Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket still buttoned, stands in a small front room with her coat on, hands at her sides, saying a thing she has come to say. Middle distance: a chair with a hard cushion, a clock on the mantel. Background: the terrace window and net curtains, late afternoon.

Delia Norrish, a woman of about fifty, a dark bob, a grey tailored coat, stands by the kitchen range with a clipboard shut under her arm and a rain coat over her sleeve. Middle distance: the shut clipboard, a teacup left on the table. Background: the low kitchen window, grey morning.

Vic Dobson, ninety-seven, thin white hair, a navy blue donkey jumper, sits very straight in a high-backed chair with a folded sheet of paper in both work-worn hands, reading it again. Middle distance: the paper, a walking stick by the chair leg. Background: a front room with net curtains, afternoon.

Foreground: a rotten fence post and a spade stuck in wet turf at the edge of a ditch. Middle: Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket, standing on the bank above them with one hand on a bare apple trunk. Background: the field boundary, low cloud. Light: midday under cloud.

Beryl Sallow, seventy-four, grey hair pinned back, a brown cardigan with the sleeves rolled, stands at the sink holding a washed plate she has stopped drying. Middle distance: the plate in her hands, the sink. Background: the kitchen range and a bright window, Monday morning.

Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket, stands in the long row in October with one russet apple in her hand and her thumb on its skin. Middle distance: a ladder leaning into a tree, fallen fruit on the grass. Background: laden trees in long rows, low golden light.

Foreground: a slatted crate of russet apples on a wet pavement beside the open boot of an old estate car. Middle: Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket, standing by it. Background: a terraced street in Nethergill. Light: September morning on the wet stone.

Dot Slee, ninety-two, white hair under a black bonnet, a dark blue coat buttoned to the throat, stands in her own doorway with one hand on the frame, looking out. Middle distance: the worn door step, a walking frame by the wall. Background: the narrow hall behind her, flat morning light.

Fen Sallow, twenty-four, dark hair tied back, a moss-green waxed jacket, stands in the hall of a terraced house, hands loose at her sides, speaking the sentence a second time. Middle distance: a russet apple set on the hall table, her car keys. Background: the stair and its worn banister, cold daylight from the door.

Dot Slee, ninety-two, white hair loose under a black bonnet, a dark blue coat, comes up a lane leaning on a walking frame and stops in the long row of apple trees. Middle distance: the walking frame, one russet apple on the grass. Background: the row of bare and fruiting trees, October evening.

Dot Slee, ninety-two, white hair loose, a dark blue coat, stands close among the apple trees with one hand flat on the trunk of the fifth tree, face turned to the side. Middle distance: the trunk under her palm, a russet apple at her boot. Background: five fruiting trees and one bare tree, last light.
